summary.text: Kelly Dooner is a Republican state senator who has represented the 3rd Bristol and Plymouth District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is the Senate's Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Kelly Dooner succeeded Marc Pacheco, a Democrat, in the Massachusetts State Senate.
Ballotpedia lists her as a 2020 candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives in the 3rd Bristol District, where she lost the general election.

In the 2025-2026 session, Dooner is the ranking minority member of the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee and of the joint committees on Community Development and Small Businesses, Higher Education, and Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure.
She also serves on the Personnel and Administration Committee and the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
